questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the give four alternatives, select the one which best expresses the meaning of the given word.** 

Plight
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. 'Difficulty'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"plight"** means a dangerous, difficult, or otherwise unfortunate situation. (संकट)
 
 
• **Example: **The plight of the refugees was heart-wrenching.
 
 
 
• **"Difficulty"** refers to a state or condition of being hard to do, deal with, or understand. (कठिनाई)
 
 
• **Example: **She faced many difficulties during her journey.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the word 'plight' is best expressed by the word 'difficulty'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. 'Difficulty'.

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the one which best expresses the meaning of the given word.** 

Articulate
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option (1)** i.e. **Distinct**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Articulate (स्पष्ट)** - Having or showing the ability to speak fluently and coherently.

 
 
• Example: She's an articulate speaker who easily engages her audience.
 
 
 
• **Distinct (विशिष्ट / अलग)** - Recognizably different in nature from something else of a similar type.
 
 
• Example: The styles of the two artists are quite distinct.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is Distinct.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• Example: The directions he gave were unclear and confusing.
 
 
 
• Disconnect (असंगतता) - A lack of connection or continuity.
 
 
• Example: There's a disconnect between what the policy says and how it's implemented.
 
 
 
• Secret (गुप्त) - Not known or seen or not meant to be known or seen by others.
 
 
• Example: He quietly shared his secret plan with his closest friend.

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the one which is opposite in meaning of the given word.** 

Distress
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option (2)** i.e. **'Pleasure'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Distress: (संकट) - It refers to extreme anxiety, sorrow, or pain.
 
 
• Example: He was in distress after losing his job.
 
 
 
• Pleasure: (आनंद) - It refers to a feeling of happiness, enjoyment, or satisfaction.
 
 
• Example: It was a pleasure to meet you.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is 'Pleasure'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Concern: (चिंता) - It refers to worry or anxiety about something.
 
 
• Example: He felt a wave of concern for her safety.
 
 
 
• Anxiety: (चिंता) - It refers to the feeling of fear, dread, or uneasiness.
 
 
• Example: She felt a sudden rush of anxiety about her upcoming exam.
 
 
 
• Discomfort: (असुविधा) - It refers to an absence of comfort or ease; uneasiness, hardship, or mild pain.
 
 
• Example: He felt discomfort from sitting in a cramped position.

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the one which is opposite in meaning of the given word.** 

Tolerate
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option (4)** i.e. **'**Disapprove**'**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tolerate: (सहन करना)** - It refers to the ability to endure or resist the action or effect of something, particularly something unpleasant or adverse.

 
 
• Example: She could not tolerate the spicy food.
 
 
 
• **Disapprove: (अस्वीकार करना)** - It refers to having or expressing an unfavorable opinion.
 
 
• Example: My parents disapprove of my decision to drop out of school.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is 'Disapprove'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Accept: (स्वीकार करना)** - It refers to the action of consenting to receive or undertake something offered.

 
 
• Example: I accept your apology.
 
 
 
• **Bear: (सहन करना)** - It refers to the ability to endure an unpleasant or difficult process or situation without giving way.
 
 
• Example: She is struggling to bear the pain.
 
 
 
• **Permit: (अनुमति देना)** - It refers to giving authorization or consent to someone to do something.
 
 
• Example: They permit visitors to take photographs in the museum.
